# Capito

> A browser extension that detects propaganda techniques and bias in online articles — while you read them.

Capito analyzes article text in real time and surfaces persuasion techniques as named, categorized findings. It does not fact-check. It counts technique density in writing style. Scores are reproducible and methodology is public.

## The Capito Index

A leaderboard ranking news outlets by technique density, aggregated from a controlled sample of articles analyzed by the same engine that runs in your browser. Rolling 6-month window, updated weekly. Scores reflect writing style, not editorial stance.

## Key pages

- `/` — Homepage with the Capito Index leaderboard
- `/techniques` — Full taxonomy field guide
- `/techniques/[slug]` — Per-technique entry with definition, examples, and cognitive mechanism
- `/outlets/[slug]` — Per-outlet score history, technique distribution, and example findings
- `/methodology` — How scores are calculated and the leaderboard is built
- `/privacy` — Privacy policy

## Install

Available as a browser extension for Chrome and Firefox. Free tier: 3 analyses/month. Plus: €4/mo. Pro: €16/mo.
